tasks.title: Music Assistant: scaffold kubernetes/apps/services/music-assistant/
tasks.description: New ks.yaml + app/{helmrelease.yaml,kustomization.yaml}, bjw-s app-template wrapping ghcr.io/music-assistant/server (renovate-tracked tag), per design spec Architecture section.
tasks.details: pod.hostNetwork: true + dnsPolicy: ClusterFirstWithHostNet (mirrors home-assistant's discovery pattern -- required for Sonos/Chromecast/AirPlay mDNS/SSDP and HA zeroconf auto-discovery). Container port 8095. Default securityContext, no extra capabilities (SYS_ADMIN/DAC_READ_SEARCH/apparmor:unconfined from upstream docs are for in-container network-share mounts, not needed since the library is a k8s-managed PVC). global.annotations reloader.stakater.com/auto: "true".

tasks.title: Music Assistant: provision /data and /music PVCs
tasks.description: /data (config/db/artwork cache) on openebs-hostpath, RWO, retain:true, ~10Gi. /music (library) on nfs-client (Synology-backed), sized 1Ti as a nominal PVC-API value only -- nfs-subdir-external-provisioner doesn't enforce quota so this isn't a real ceiling.

tasks.title: Music Assistant: confirm PVCs covered by Velero (no exclusion label)
tasks.description: Verify neither the /data nor /music PVC is added to kubernetes/apps/velero/exclusions/app/pvc-exclusions.yaml -- daily wildcard backup should cover both by default.

tasks.title: Music Assistant: HTTPRoute music.68cc.io
tasks.description: traefik-internal-gateway (VIP 192.168.35.17) + authentik-forwardauth Middleware on the UI route, no Cloudflare public record -- internal-only, matching home-assistant's posture.
tasks.details: No bypass paths anticipated (HA<->MA talks over host network via zeroconf, not through this route). Revisit if MA's frontend breaks behind the forwardAuth cookie flow during testing.

tasks.title: Music Assistant: deploy standalone, validate web UI + player discovery
tasks.description: Confirm web UI reachable on :8095 and via music.68cc.io. Confirm Sonos/Chromecast/AirPlay speakers on the LAN are discovered automatically.

tasks.title: Music Assistant: configure Tidal provider
tasks.description: Complete the PKCE browser auth flow from MA's web UI. Confirm the resulting session token persists in /data and survives a pod restart (PVC-backed, not lost). No SOPS secret involved -- see design spec Secrets section.

tasks.title: Music Assistant: install/verify Home Assistant integration
tasks.description: Add the native "Music Assistant" integration in HA's UI. Expect auto-discovery via zeroconf since both pods run with hostNetwork on the same LAN; fall back to manual host-IP:8095 entry if discovery doesn't fire. No changes to home-assistant's own manifests -- this is a runtime HA config step, not GitOps state.

tasks.title: Music Assistant backlog: populate /music PVC with library files
tasks.description: Out-of-band step -- copy files onto the Synology NFS export backing the /music PVC once the export path is known. Not a blocker for standing up the app itself.

tasks.title: Music Assistant backlog: evaluate additional streaming providers
tasks.description: Spotify or others, if desired later. Tidal is the only provider in scope for the initial deployment.
